text.headline: Book Zero: Timeline, 1980–2000
text.text:
Facts as stated by the author. Each entry says whether it is documented, stated, a family account, computed, or still open.

Some memories are incomplete. Where an entry ends with a question, readers who were there are welcome to help fill it in.

text.headline: Born at Hospital Felício Rocho, Belo Horizonte
text.text:
Document: place, date and time of birth (Friday, 00:48).

Open: why his parents chose that hospital.

Computed: Venus was the evening star on the night of 28 February, about 43° east of the Sun, magnitude −4.0, setting near 20:30 local time (ephem library, approximate). Friday is Venus's day.

Family account: the birth is linked to the carnival period. The official carnival days were 16–19 February 1980 (computed).

text.headline: The family in Brasília
text.text:
Stated: the family moved to Brasília, where his brother and sister were born, from 1982.

Open: year of the move, the siblings' birth dates, why the family moved. The 1982 marker is the earliest date stated, not the move date.

text.headline: Moved to 104s, a new apartment
text.text:
Stated: the family moved to a new apartment in 104s before he turned 6 (his sixth birthday fell in 1986). There he met most of his childhood friends.

Stated: the grandparents came over for Christmas in the new apartment.

Stated memory: he was into toys at the time, got the one he wanted, and remembers getting up to find it: The Flash, from 1986, the hero who ran really fast; the figure had a mechanical movement, you moved its legs. (He remembers it as a Marvel hero; The Flash is a DC Comics character.)

Stated: one friend is the exception: they went to school together at about age 5, before the move, and are still friends.

Open: which Christmas (1985 is likely if the move came before the 1986 birthday), the exact move date, what 104s refers to (likely a Brasília block, not confirmed), the toy's maker and product line, whether the memory is from that Christmas, the friends' names (only with their agreement).

text.headline: Petrobras, oil platforms, and a science fair
text.text:
Stated: in 1989 (age 9) he developed a sudden interest in Petrobras and oil platforms, and competed in a science fair.

Stated: he studied at Objetivo at some point, and says that was this period.

Open: whether the science fair was at Objetivo, the project he entered, which fair, the result, what sparked the interest, how long he attended Objetivo, and the school he attended before it.

text.headline: Moved to CASEB, a public school
text.text:
Stated: in 1993 he moved to CASEB, a public school.

Stated memory: he was about six months ahead of the group. The teacher said things he already knew, and he would finish the teacher's sentences.

Open: his grade, why he changed schools, how the teacher and classmates reacted, and what happened next.

text.headline: Escola de Música de Brasília
text.text:
Stated: around this time (1993) he studied at the Escola de Música de Brasília, and met the people he played music with.

Stated: he studied musicografia rather than an instrument, on a full-time schedule of four classes, in a program that leads to a bachelor's degree. The four classes: canto coral (choral singing), rhythm percussion, music theory and musicografia.

Open: whether he played an instrument with the group, the band or group, the members (names only with their agreement), how long he studied there, whether he finished the program, the first time they played together.

text.headline: Punk rock, bass, and the Grêmio Estudantil
text.text:
Stated: by 1994 he had decided to play with the band instead of continuing the music school program. Punk rock felt like his thing.

Stated: the band was called MOFO.

Stated: the kids from CASEB made him a bass player.

Stated: he revived the Grêmio Estudantil (student union) at CASEB, served as its cultural director, and planned a concert for the Festa Junina.

Stated: the concert happened, his parents saw him play, and he remembers it as funny.

Stated memory: another band played too. He also remembers a kid they called Turco, who he doesn't think was Turkish. He can't remember the other band's name.

Stated memory: the Festa Junina was pretty fun. At that party he met a red-haired girl who went to the same school in the afternoon program. He wishes he had kept a picture or an album of those days.

Open: the band's members (names only with their agreement), whether the Grêmio had lapsed or been dissolved before he revived it, who else served with him, the other band's members (the name is not remembered), what Turco's role was (band, friend or classmate) and why he got the nickname, what was funny about it, what happened with the red-haired girl, whether he left the music school completely, the first bass he played, and whether any photos exist (parents, classmates, CASEB).

Stated reflection: being a teenager was the time to make mistakes, so he was a punk trying to err a little, and he had to learn a lot from his own actions.

If you were there, help me remember. CASEB, Brasília, 1994: the band MOFO, the Grêmio Estudantil, the Festa Junina concert. Do you remember the other bands that played, the kid we called Turco, the photos, or anything else from that day? Your memories will be added to this timeline, with your permission.

text.headline: First love
text.text:
Stated: in 1995 (age 15) he met his first love. He later married, and he and his spouse came to the United States.

Open: the years of the marriage and of the move to the United States. He has chosen to keep the rest of this part private.

text.headline: S.L.U., commercials, and a movie extra
text.text:
Stated: in 1996 (age 16) there was a new band, S.L.U. (his essay O Futuro Em Suas Mãos says it formed after M.O.F.O.).

Stated: by then he had done commercials and been a movie extra.

Stated: by then he had been working for a couple of years for his mother.

Open: how S.L.U. formed and with whom (names only with their agreement), what the commercials and the film were, the kind of work he did for his mother, and whether S.L.U. formed in 1996 or earlier.
